title: Deep Learning
summary: Neural networks from the first neuron to transformers: build one from scratch, then master PyTorch, training, CNNs, LSTMs, attention, LLMs and deployment.
outcomes: Explain neurons, layers, activations, loss, backpropagation and gradient descent, and build a network from scratch in NumPy
Use PyTorch tensors, autograd, nn.Module and the standard training loop with DataLoaders
Choose optimisers and learning rates, and fight overfitting with dropout, weight decay and early stopping
Diagnose vanishing gradients and silent training bugs with a practical checklist
Build convolutional networks for images and apply transfer learning
Understand RNNs, LSTMs, embeddings, attention and transformers, then LLMs, LoRA fine-tuning, deployment and responsible AI
